scope: GT25 virtual-IMU transfer segment estimates used by the BT07 streaming pilot; walking initialization is a separate branch.

evidence.claim: imu_sim signals are in OpenSim body segment frames; accelerations m/s^2 and gyroscope deg/s. No explicit conversion to global sagittal angle is specified.

For each segment/side, compute atan2(mean first acceleration x, mean first acceleration y), add cumulative body gyro-z radians using a constant dt, then subtract mean of final 20 samples for sit-to-stand or first 20 for stand-to-sit.
Streaming transfer worker always uses acceleration-init branch and whole-recording endpoint-derived mean dt.
task_info identifies virtual IMU integration with converter initialization, but does not name the standing-relative per-segment reference or local-axis assumption.
Canonical segment angles are described as link/segment orientations in space and anatomical sagittal forward/backward tilt. No explicit universal numerical zero is defined here.

proven_properties: In the transfer branch, a constant accelerometer initialization cancels exactly algebraically: (a+cumulative_rotation)-mean(a+cumulative_rotation)=cumulative_rotation-mean(cumulative_rotation). It does not establish retained absolute gravity orientation.
Each segment is independently zeroed to a selected standing interval; source standing orientations and cross-segment angular offsets are removed.
Velocity is the derivative of the resampled relative scalar estimate; offset subtraction does not establish its global sagittal-axis meaning.
Independent raw readback reproduces this algorithm and cannot establish missing global-frame correspondence.
unsupported_assumptions: Body-frame gyro-z integration is a global sagittal segment angle without a reviewed rotation/axis mapping. Exact model body axes and source virtual-IMU producer definitions have not been established in this review.
The standing interval has zero physical orientation for thigh, shank and foot independently.
A uniform whole-record mean dt is an exact orientation integration clock if timestamps are irregular; existing audit checks reproduce this approximation.
not_claimed: No source gyro sign reversal is proven.
No exact alternative global orientation transform is proposed.
No scientific output was loaded, modified or newly withheld.
Canonical documentation does not explicitly define a universal zero angle, so source metadata omission alone is distinguished from proof of a particular numerical correction.

recommended_review_decision.immediate: Add explicit source body-frame, gyro-z integration, separate standing-relative neutral reference, acceleration-initialization cancellation and model-derived estimate metadata before representing these as absolute orientations.
recommended_review_decision.if_canonical_orientation_requires_global: Preserve all 12 existing segment angle/velocity estimates and masks in explicitly derived/source-relative aliases, and withhold unsupported canonical orientation labels in a separate reviewed successor. Do not alter frozen v4 automatically.
recommended_review_decision.needed_for_canonical_support: Exact source producer/model axis definitions and a reviewed body-to-global orientation mapping, with a known-pose fixture. Waveform agreement is insufficient.

pilot_relation: v4 remains a bounded ankle/normalization source-readback pilot with unresolved segment semantics, not full scientific approval.
